bio: As well as haebel, just across the street, Fabio Haebel runs this trendy, laid-back establishment in the heart of St Pauli. Spread over two floors, the restaurant has an agreeably lively atmosphere. Upstairs there are also a few seats at a counter facing the open kitchen. The cuisine is modern with seafood specialties and vegetarian dishes. Options include daily specials and classics such as tinned sardines in oil with new potatoes, quark and dill. Alternatively, you could opt for Chef's Choice – a selection of items to be shared, picked from the menu by the kitchen team. There is also a small cocktail bar and a lovely terrace where you can enjoy the hustle and bustle....
